title: Fullness of the Spirit
definition: Fullness of the Spirit is the ongoing Spirit-filled condition of believers who are yielded to God, shaped by worship, gratitude, wisdom, and obedience.
summary: Believers are commanded to be filled with the Holy Spirit.
christFocus: Jesus gives the Spirit so His people may live in worship, holiness, courage, and love.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Fullness of the Spirit is not a one-time emotional high. Scripture commands believers to be filled with the Spirit as an ongoing pattern of life.

Ephesians connects Spirit-filled life with worship, thanksgiving, mutual submission, wisdom, and obedience. Acts shows Spirit-filled believers speaking the Word with boldness and serving faithfully.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Many people reduce Spirit-filled life to emotion or a particular experience. This doctrine matters because Scripture describes a whole life yielded to God's presence and power.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Ask God to fill you with the Spirit. Yield your speech, worship, relationships, service, and obedience to His work.

relatedTopics: Indwelling and Filling of the Holy Spirit
